name: Lambholt
description: Village where Vadrik was called by the elders.

timeline.summary: Arlinn, in wolf form, races toward the besieged town of Lambholt smelling angel's blood.
timeline.quote: The aroma met Arlinn's wide wolf nostrils as she raced up the sheer incline of a gorge toward the town of Lambholt under siege.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Arlinn witnessed a mad angel's descent on Lambholt, which left cathars and civilians slain.
timeline.quote: She had witnessed the mad angel's descent on Lambholt from afar

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Arlinn finds a mad angel bound in a clearing, surrounded by cathars.
timeline.quote: The angel was bound with rope, an arrow protruding from her gut, wings bloodied.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Arlinn sees Rembert, whose three long scars shine in the moonlight.
timeline.quote: Though Rembert's face was red from effort and crusted in dirt, the three long, white scars that ran across his cheek and down his jaw shone in the moonlight.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: A branch snaps and the mad angel points out Arlinn the werewolf to the cathars.
timeline.quote: There in the trees! A monster!

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Distracted cathars step back, and the mad angel breaks her ropes and takes flight.
timeline.quote: In a display of mad strength, she spread her wings with enough force to cast off the ropes that bound her.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The mad angel hurls an arrow that kills the youngest cathar.
timeline.quote: she tore the arrow from her gut and hurled it down at the youngest of the cathars.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Rembert attacks Arlinn with a branch and orders the cathars to kill the monster.
timeline.quote: Rembert was wielding the branch as a weapon, against her.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Cornered at the gorge by Rembert and the cathars, Arlinn braces for blows.
timeline.quote: She was surrounded, backed against the edge of the gorge, cathars on all sides and Rembert before her

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The mad angel seizes Rembert and carries him into the air.
timeline.quote: The angel shrieked as it closed its bloody fingers around Rembert's arms and pulled him, gasping and wide-eyed, into the air.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Arlinn leaps up, pulls the angel to the ground and kills her, freeing Rembert.
timeline.quote: The mad angel was dead in the matter of moments.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Rembert is wounded, lying on a dead tree trunk in the gorge, and Arlinn climbs out to reach him.
timeline.quote: Rembert was wounded, lying on a twisted trunk of a dead tree

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Arlinn transforms to human form and offers Rembert her hand; he admits she lied and killed the others, yet takes it.
timeline.quote: Arlinn closed her eyes and welcomed the transformation to her human form

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Arlinn tells Rembert that Avacyn is gone and they must find strength in each other.
timeline.quote: We must find strength in each other.

citation.text: "The Archmage of Goldnight" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Vadrik arrives at Lambholt at night, called for help, and is nearly shot by a nervous guard.
timeline.quote: a crossbow bolt flew past his head and sunk halfway to its fletching into a nearby alder

citation.text: "His Eyes, All of Them" by Margaret Killjoy. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Vadrik meets the council of crones and mothers and the inquisitor Rem Karolus, who was hired by Dein Salvasi, and they agree to work together.
timeline.quote: "Then I suppose we'll be working together."

citation.text: "His Eyes, All of Them" by Margaret Killjoy. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The council explains the disappearances of Arinos and travelers and the death of Lakil; Malynn says that Old Stickfingers has come out of rhyme and story.
timeline.quote: "It was Old Stickfingers, it was," Malynn said.

citation.text: "His Eyes, All of Them" by Margaret Killjoy. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: A man bursts in to report another murder.
timeline.quote: "Murder," he finally got out. "Murder."

citation.text: "His Eyes, All of Them" by Margaret Killjoy. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Vadrik examines three bodies in a pasture, one a werewolf reverted on death, all pierced as if by arrows.
timeline.quote: Well, two dead people and one dead werewolf

citation.text: "His Eyes, All of Them" by Margaret Killjoy. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Vadrik casts a tracking spell with star dust and, annoyed at Rem calling him a hound, makes Rem's mouth vanish briefly.
timeline.quote: His mouth, more importantly, was gone, disappeared by Vadrik's magic.

citation.text: "His Eyes, All of Them" by Margaret Killjoy. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The two follow the tracks to an aspen grove where Old Stickfingers appears behind Vadrik.
timeline.quote: Old Stickfingers lived up to his name.

citation.text: "His Eyes, All of Them" by Margaret Killjoy. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Rem stabs Stickfingers and Vadrik blasts him with ice; Rem drives his blade through the creature's face and it vanishes.
timeline.quote: Rem stood up and drove his blade through the beast's chin, up through his face.

citation.text: "His Eyes, All of Them" by Margaret Killjoy. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: In the morning Vadrik meets Ariosa, Arinos's daughter, and sets out to investigate the Salvasi manor.
timeline.quote: "Vadrik, meet Ariosa. Daughter of Arinos."

citation.text: "His Eyes, All of Them" by Margaret Killjoy. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: At Arinos's farm Vadrik finds a twig mobile and deduces that Arinos summoned Stickfingers to get rid of Salvasi.
timeline.quote: "Arinos summoned Stickfingers to dispose of Salvasi and save his farm," Vadrik said.

citation.text: "His Eyes, All of Them" by Margaret Killjoy. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Vadrik crushes the mobile with Stickfingers's blood on it, thinking this will unsummon him, and a keening comes from the alders.
timeline.quote: He then raised one boot and slammed it down, crushing the thing underfoot.

citation.text: "His Eyes, All of Them" by Margaret Killjoy. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: The village bell tolls: Stickfingers is inside the walls, and Ariosa says that Vadrik and Rem set him free.
timeline.quote: "Just came from home," she said to Malynn, then she looked daggers at the pair of men. "They set him free."

citation.text: "His Eyes, All of Them" by Margaret Killjoy. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Malynn explains that Stickfingers is a hearth spirit of this place and cannot be sent away; Vadrik realizes he was summoned to protect, not to kill.
timeline.quote: "So he was summoned, not to kill, but to protect?"

citation.text: "His Eyes, All of Them" by Margaret Killjoy. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Vadrik works out that Arinos did not finish the summoning, so Stickfingers killed intruders on the old estate's land; Rem holds the monster back and Vadrik heals him.
timeline.quote: Killed Arinos as an intruder on his own land.

citation.text: "His Eyes, All of Them" by Margaret Killjoy. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Ariosa repairs the mobile and sings the binding, offering a goat; Stickfingers appears, accepts the goat and walks off peacefully as guardian of her home.
timeline.quote: Stickfingers barked, and the white goat ambled over to him.

citation.text: "His Eyes, All of Them" by Margaret Killjoy. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Vadrik declines Rem's offer to team up and rides home, but wonders why the second bed was made and why Ariosa survived unscathed.
timeline.quote: How odd it was that Ariosa had survived, unscathed.

citation.text: "His Eyes, All of Them" by Margaret Killjoy. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 19 Sep 2021.

timeline.summary: Facing loss of his farm, Arinos summoned Old Stickfingers to eliminate Salvasi.
timeline.quote: Arinos called forth Old Stickfingers

citation.text: "Arinos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The summoning went wrong; Old Stickfingers broke free and attacked Arinos and the villagers.
timeline.quote: Old Stickfingers broke free, turning on his summoner

citation.text: "Arinos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vadrik and Rem Karolus confronted Old Stickfingers; Vadrik destroyed the mobile and Ariosa finished the ritual, ending its rampage.
timeline.quote: Vadrik destroyed the mobile

citation.text: "Arinos", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arinos summons Old Stickfingers to protect his home from Dein Salvasi; the ritual goes wrong and Arinos disappears while murders begin.
timeline.quote: This dark ritual went wrong, leading to Arinos's disappearance

citation.text: "Ariosa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vadrik and Rem begin investigating and link Old Stickfingers to Ariosa's father; Ariosa gives Vadrik information.
timeline.quote: Ariosa provided crucial information to Vadrik

citation.text: "Ariosa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vadrik and Rem destroy the mobile used in the summoning, which only unbinds Stickfingers from its hearth.
timeline.quote: destroying the mobile used in the summoning ritual

citation.text: "Ariosa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ariosa performs the second part of the ritual, specifying Stickfingers should kill only those she marks; she knows all the words of the poem.
timeline.quote: Ariosa knew all the words of the poem that needed to be recited

citation.text: "Ariosa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Old Stickfingers takes his goats and vanishes into the woods; Vadrik and Rem leave Lambholt, troubled by two made beds and a green glow.
timeline.quote: Old Stickfingers took his goats and vanished into the woods

citation.text: "Ariosa", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Inquisitors declare Eruth a heretic and plan to execute her; she flees to the Natterknolls.
timeline.quote: Evading the Cathars, she fled Lambholt to the Natterknolls

citation.text: "Eruth", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Hailin encourages Vadrik to take on the Lambholt mission to clear his head.
timeline.quote: Hailin encouraged Vadrik to take on the adventure, suggesting it would clear his head and help him focus on his studies

citation.text: "Hailin", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Malynn, among the council of crones and mothers, calls Vadrik to Lambholt and asserts Old Stickfingers is responsible for the murders.
timeline.quote: She immediately asserted her belief that Old Stickfingers

citation.text: "Malynn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Malynn gives Vadrik and Rem Karolus lore about Old Stickfingers.
timeline.quote: Malynn provided valuable insight and historical context about Old Stickfingers

citation.text: "Malynn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vadrik and the inquisitor confront Old Stickfingers in a grove; Vadrik destroys the twig mobile that summoned it.
timeline.quote: Vadrik used his magical abilities to analyze and ultimately disrupt the summoning of Old Stickfingers

citation.text: "Malynn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ariosa finishes the summoning ritual properly, ending the threat to the village.
timeline.quote: effectively ending the threat against the village

citation.text: "Malynn", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Arinos invokes Old Stickfingers but the ritual is incomplete, so it kills several people in Lambholt.
timeline.quote: causing Old Stickfingers to kill several people across the village of Lambholt

citation.text: "Old Stickfingers", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rem Karolus and Vadrik are called to investigate the deaths.
timeline.quote: The cathar Rem Karolus and the archmage Vadrik were called in to investigate the mysterious deaths.

citation.text: "Old Stickfingers", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vadrik and Ariosa contain Old Stickfingers by completing the ritual.
timeline.quote: managed to contain Old Stickfingers by completing the ritual

citation.text: "Old Stickfingers", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Karolus and Vadrik are hired to find the vanished farmer Arinos.
timeline.quote: Karolus and the astronomer Vadrik were employed to find a farmer named Arinos

citation.text: "Rem Karolus", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: They wound Old Stickfingers, learn Arinos summoned it to kill Salvasi, and banish it.
timeline.quote: After employing a ritual to banish Old Stickfingers, Vadrik and Rem parted on good terms.

citation.text: "Rem Karolus", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vadrik goes to Lambholt after being called by village elders and meets Rem Karolus; both are employed to find the missing farmer Arinos.
timeline.quote: Vadrik went to Lambholt , after being called upon by the village elders.

citation.text: "Vadrik", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vadrik, Rem and Malynn find Old Stickfingers and fight and wound it.
timeline.quote: engaged it in battle, wounding it

citation.text: "Vadrik", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Ariosa reveals Salvasi threatened to take Arinos' lands; the group finds Salvasi's house deserted and learns Arinos summoned Old Stickfingers to kill Salvasi.
timeline.quote: it was in fact Arinos who had summoned Old Stickfingers to kill Salvasi

citation.text: "Vadrik", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vadrik and Rem contain Old Stickfingers with a ritual and part on good terms; Vadrik returns home to his husband.
timeline.quote: After employing a ritual to contain Old Stickfingers

citation.text: "Vadrik", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
